title: Evaluate Responsive Layout Audit Prompt
task: In a fictional engineering repository, for a modal containing prompt code, measure document and dialog overflow at 1440, 390, and 320 pixels, stress long links, and verify the copy control and references remain reachable.
acceptance_criteria: Viewport and zoom matrix results with measured document and component overflow.
Screenshots or live observations for representative content, interactive states, overlays, and dense regions.
Source evidence identifying the exact sizing or layout rule responsible for each issue.
Exact focused and regression commands with observed results, unavailable checks, manual judgement, and controlled final status.
failure_signals: Reject responsive approval based on desktop and one mobile screenshot alone.
Reject fixes that hide essential content or reorder focus incorrectly.
